mapper.select: SELECT state FROM posts WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT state FROM comments WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
SELECT user_id FROM posts WHERE post_id = #{postId}
SELECT user_id FROM comments WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO moderation_log (target_type, target_id, applied_state, reason_id, detail, acted_by, created_at) VALUES (#{entry.targetType}, #{entry.targetId}, #{entry.appliedState}, #{entry.reasonId}, #{entry.detail}, #{entry.actedBy}, NOW())

INSERT INTO penalty_log (user_id, points, target_type, target_id, source_action_id, created_at, expires_at) SELECT #{userId}, CAST(COALESCE((SELECT setting_value FROM policy_settings WHERE code = 'caution_per_delete'), '2') AS SIGNED), #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{sourceActionId}, NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL CAST(COALESCE((SELECT setting_value FROM policy_settings WHERE code = 'caution_ttl_days'), '365') AS SIGNED) DAY)
